$comment: Brief 35 §B — the API origin each environment is built against, IN TRACKED CONFIG.
This value used to live only in apps/pwa/.env, which is gitignored. A build on any
machine without that file — a fresh clone, a CI runner, a new laptop — produced a PWA
with an EMPTY API origin. That build still activated, still recorded locally, still
showed an active alert, and never created an event, never notified a contact, never
uploaded a byte. The deploy passed because the build ids matched. Same failure shape as
migration 0038 and the same reasoning as the ENVELOPE_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED var in
wrangler.toml: config the product cannot function without does not belong in a file that
does not travel with the source.
NOT A SECRET. These are public origins — they are in every network request the PWA makes.
Secrets stay in `wrangler secret put` / .dev.vars and are never read from here.
.env is still supported for LOCAL DEVELOPMENT only. The deploy pipeline passes the value
below into the build environment, which takes precedence over any .env file, so a stale
local .env can never decide what production points at.
